headline: Applied Digital says another 75 megawatts of computing power is now ready for use at its North Dakota AI data center campus, bringing the site to 250 megawatts.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a real capacity milestone, but it is the company's own announcement and names no customer.
importance_line: It shows one AI data center campus moving from construction to working capacity, which matters to its customers and to investors in the company, but the figures are the company's own and the customer is not named.
summary: Applied Digital said in a press release on 2 Oct 2026 that a further 75 megawatts of computing capacity (a measure of the electrical power its equipment can draw) is ready for service at its Polaris Forge 1 campus in Ellendale, North Dakota, bringing the site to 250 megawatts of the 400 megawatts it is contracted to deliver. The company describes the campus as fully leased, but its release does not name the customer, and the figures are the company's own.
notes: Company press release (GlobeNewswire), not independent reporting.
